meta.title: An awarded event: "Rejected Bids" opens the "Rejected Bids" window
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event directly on its RFQ Responses screen.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the buyer tenant as required by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Rejected Bids.
Verify that the Rejected Bids window opens.
Verify that the window provides the Close button and remains open for inspection.
